{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().reset_index()
conversion_rates = conversion_rates.rename(columns={'converted': 'conversion_rate'})

# Sort by conversion rate descending to find the highest
conversion_rates = conversion_rates.sort_values(by='conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Display the conversion rates
conversion_rates"}
